theorem lg_target {K : Type u_1} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {x : K} {m n : ℕ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h'x : x < 1) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) := by
  have hgeom : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i = (x ^ m - x ^ n) / (1 - x) := geom_sum_Ico' hx (le_refl m)
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i ≤ (x ^ m - x ^ n) / (1 - x) : by rw hgeom
  ... ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) : by {
    have h1 : 0 < 1 - x := by {
      have h2 : 0 < 1 := by linarith
      have h3 : x < 1 := h'x
      exact lt_sub_iff_add_lt.1 (lt_trans h3 h2)
    }
    have h4 : x ^ n ≤ 1 := by {
      induction n with k IH,
      · exact le_rfl
      · rw [pow_succ, pow_succ] at IH ⊢
        have h5 : x ^ k ≤ 1 := IH
        have h6 : 0 ≤ x := hx
        have h7 : x < 1 := h'x
        have h8 : x ^ (k + 1) ≤ x := by {
          apply mul_le_mul_of_pos_left h6 h7
          exact le_rfl
        }
        exact le_trans h8 h5
    }
    have h5 : 0 < 1 - x := h1
    have h6 : 0 ≤ x ^ n := by linarith
    have h7 : (x ^ m - x ^ n) / (1 - x) ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) :=
      div_le_div_right (le_sub_iff_add_le.2 (le_trans (le_zero_iff_neg.mpr (le_add_right h6 h1)) (le_refl _))) h1
    exact h7
  }
